camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
description_en: Queries the details of a live interactive group
description_zh: 查询直播互动群组详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_en: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Currently supported values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

Createtime.description_en: The creation time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Createtime.description_zh: 创建时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

Deletatime.description_en: The deletion time. This parameter is returned only when the group has been deleted. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Deletatime.description_zh: 删除时间。群组已被删除时才有此参数。用 UNIX 时间戳表示，单位：秒

Delete.description_en: Indicates whether the group has been deleted

Deletor.description_en: The user who deleted the group. This parameter is returned only when the group has been deleted
Deletor.description_zh: 删除者。群组已被删除时才有此参数

GroupInfo.description_en: The extended information of the group

MsgAmount.description_en: The message count statistics by category. This parameter is returned only when the group exists
MsgAmount.description_zh: 消息数分类统计。群组存在时才有此参数

OnlineUserCounts.description_en: The number of online users in the group. This parameter is returned only when the group exists
OnlineUserCounts.description_zh: 当前在线的群用户数。群组存在时才有此参数

SuperLargeGroup.description_en:
Indicates whether the group is a super large group. Valid values:
True: The group is a super large group.
False: The group is not a super large group
SuperLargeGroup.description_zh:
群组是否为超级大群。
True：是。
False：否

TotalTimes.description_en: The total number of sessions. This parameter is returned only when the group exists
TotalTimes.description_zh: 总Session次数。群组存在时才有此参数
